subject: general
question: If Cosec θ + Cot θ = m, find the value of frac{m²−1}{m²+1}.
solution:
Identity used:

cosec²θ – cot²θ = 1

Calculation:

⇒ cosec θ + cot θ = m ---- (1)

⇒ (cosec θ - cot θ)(cosec θ + cot θ) = 1

⇒ (cosec θ - cot θ) =1/m

⇒ cosec θ - cot θ = 1/m ---- (2)

By adding (1) and (2), we'll get

2cosecθ = m + 1/m

cosecθ = (m² + 1)/2m ...(3)

By subtracting (1) and (2), we'll get

2cotθ = m - 1/m ...(4)

cotθ = (m2 - 1)/2m

⇒ frac{m²−1}{m²+1}

Putting eq. (3) annd (4) in above expression:

⇒ 2mcotθ/2mcosecθ 

⇒ cotθ/cosecθ

⇒ cosθ

**The value is cosθ.**
